what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Zimbabwe, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2024, IDMC estimated 401 people displaced by conflict and violence, while UNHCR's file shows none.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Zimbabwe in these years, so it does not say why people were displaced by violence.
IDMC's disaster records for Zimbabwe list floods and storms.

when.text: In 2024, the main year of displacement in the data, IDMC recorded 140 new displacements by conflict and violence.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 2191 new displacements by disasters, also counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Zimbabwe.
